messages:
Priya S: Heads up 1 infra put a hold on the multi-tenant routing piece needed for v1 of the model-router. We need a quick scope decision: can we cut v1 features and ship an MVP route for customers?
Ethan V: What's the blocker? Is it compliance or just capacity?
Nora (eng): Capacity + a last-minute networking dependency. Pooling mesh team slipped by ~2 weeks. Means multi-tenant routing & autoscale won't be ready for the planned v1 date.
Leah K: For clarity: v1 was supposed to include tenant-level QoS, routing policies, and A/B rollout hooks. MVP could be single-tenant routing + manual A/B.
Priya S: Our objective is to validate adoption and the routing abstraction. Proposal: MVP = single-tenant routes for early customers, limited to 3 tenants, manual scaling, and rollouts via feature-flag. v1 keeps multi-tenant autoscale + policy engine.
Carlos D: +1 for MVP. Also recommend we freeze non-essential platform telemetry to reduce noise and prioritize `route.latency`, `route.errors`, `route.fallbacks` metrics.
Ethan V: We should define launch criteria so sales/support know what to expect. My draft criteria:
- Pilot onboarding: max 3 customers (Acme, Nova, Helix)
- Traffic cap per tenant: 150rps
- Median p95 latency < 180ms (end-to-end)
- No >5% error rate sustained for 15m windows
If we hit these, move to v1 planning; otherwise hold.
Leah K: Add a quality check: sample 1% of routed outputs and validate against policy rules and origin model diffs. If `origin_diff_pct` > 2% we need to escalate.
Nora (eng): Work items to enable MVP:
1) feature flags `router.mvp_enable` + `router.manual_rollout`
2) telemetry dashboard (2d)
3) manual runbook for scaling & fallbacks (1d)
4) customer onboarding checklist + consent (Priya)
DeployBot: Deploy: canary started for `feat/router-mvp` at 4412345700 to staging.
Carlos D: We'll also temporarily disable global autoscale triggers to prevent accidental scaling. Ops will run a watch for 72h post-onboard.
Priya S: Timeline suggestion:
- Day 0: Product sign-off on MVP scope (today)
- Day 1-2: Flags + runbook + dashboard
- Day 3: internal staging canary + soak
- Day 4: pilot onboarding with Acme
- Day 10: review metrics + decide promote to v1 planning or pause
Ethan V: Sounds reasonable. Set the decision gate to be metric-driven (hit rate, latency, diffs) not just elapsed time.
Leah K: Customer comms note should include known limitations: no multi-tenant QoS, manual scaling, and limited tenant caps. Also ask customers to share representative traffic patterns.
Priya S: Action items:
- Priya: draft pilot customer note + consent form (EOD)
- Nora: add flags and do staging canary (24h)
- Carlos: prep ops watch & disable autoscale triggers (12h)
- Ethan: write launch criteria doc (EOD)
- Leah: sampling & diff-check plan (2d)
DeployBot: Alert: staging canary experienced an increased tail latency at 4412345755, investigating.
Nora (eng): Saw a spike on one instance; working on root cause. Might be an env mismatch in canary config.
Priya S: If staging is unstable hold pilot onboarding. Keep updates here.
Ethan V: I'll draft a short note for customers that outlines MVP limitations and expected timeline to v1. Will share for review in the channel.
Carlos D: One more ask: add a temporary quota policy `router.mvp_quota` to ensure pilot safety (default 150rps).
Leah K: Agree. Also create a short rollback plan: flip `router.mvp_enable=false` and disable tenant access; that's reversible.
Priya S: Good. Let's reconvene tomorrow 11am PT for sign-off. Thanks everyone.
